adapter_role: Deterministic schema adaptation and immutable-byte binding only
non_self_contained_historical_evidence: The original reviews document private audit inputs and deleted historical generated build inputs. Importing the reviews does not recover those bytes or claim a self-contained archived toolchain.
preservation: Original input files remain untouched in private preparation. Each imported copy records original and transformed SHA-256 and byte count; unchanged inputs preserve their exact bytes. Transformed JSON is reserialized only after recursive path-token substitution. Findings, caveats and verdicts are not edited.
remaining_root_stages: Review and install the staged replay tree using the root candidate writer
Run the actual finalizer mechanical and prepare stages
Obtain the separate actual final-stage independent review bound to FINAL_STAGE.json
Run the patched finalizer seal: it verifies the bound original build audit and carries all five exact coverage limits into unresolved_defects

schema_mappings.render: pdfs[stem].pdf_sha256 and renders -> pdf.sha256 and pages; all contact/high-resolution files retained byte-for-byte
schema_mappings.visual: Actual page decision labels whitelisted and exposed as disposition PASS; original labels, page observations, inspection methods and scope limits retained.
